request_user:
Fact: safety_evaluation
What to find: Safety evaluation, red-teaming or risk assessment performed and its results.
Card sections that often contain it: Safety, Responsibility, Red Teaming, Risks

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card reports a Safety benchmark score in its evaluation table: 89.5 for Olmo 3.1 32B Instruct (92.1 SFT, 88.9 DPO). The comparison models scored 77.1 (Apertus 70B), 81.6 (Qwen 3 32B No Think), 85.8 (Qwen 3 VL 32B Instruct), 82.2 (Qwen 2.5 32B), 68.8 (Gemma 3 27B), 74.4 (Gemma 2 27B) and 84.2 (OLMo 2 32B). The card describes no red-teaming or further risk assessment. Its risk section only warns that the models can easily be prompted to generate harmful content.
quotes: Like any base language model or fine-tuned model without safety filtering, these models can easily be prompted by users to generate harmful and sensitive content.
